steps.script: (()=>{const ids=["addNewNode", "updateBtn"];const bad=ids.filter(id=>{const b=document.getElementById(id);const v=!!b&&b.offsetParent!==null&&getComputedStyle(b).display!=='none';return v!==true});if(bad.length)throw new Error('버튼 노출 불일치(기대 표시): '+bad.join(','));})()
